columns: updated_at timestamp with time zone not null

limitations: This proves the migration against one disposable local PostgreSQL 16 instance only.
The approved production credential delivery channel and production identity mapping remain unverified.
A repeat against the exact candidate overlay and SHA is required before REM-057 can close.
Migration 0175 has no revert script; rollback must keep its additive schema and run the old application, while a new application requires 0175 to be applied. No schema-down operation was tested.

operational_documentation.recorded_contract: 0175 has no down migration; application rollback keeps its additive schema; the old binary is expected to ignore new objects, while the new binary requires 0175.
operational_documentation.production_status: the proposed dedicated migration login, object grants, identity and approved secret channel are not configured or approved for a target
operational_documentation.mixed_version_status: documented expectation only; exact old/new candidate binaries have not been exercised

design_decision.problem: Run migration 0175 without administrator credentials while preserving tenant isolation and application rollback.
current_facts: The migration runner accepts the database identity from its connection URL.
The existing installer capability role is NOLOGIN and is not a migration login.
The prior generic migration harness uses an administrator and published host port, so it is not evidence for this contract.
A disposable local run succeeded with a non-superuser login and object ownership limited to the tables/schema needed by 0175.
unknowns: Approved production migration identity and secret provider
Exact grants/ownership policy in the deployment target
Compatibility of the release-specific old/new application binaries
constraints: No shared database, service, port, target or real credential was used.
The proof must run offline with synthetic data and clean up only its own container and temporary files.
invariants: Runtime API/worker credentials do not apply migrations.
Migration login cannot be superuser, create databases/roles, replicate or bypass RLS.
Tenant-scoped reads remain isolated after account version initialization.
Application rollback preserves additive migration schema; no schema-down action.
candidates_considered: Reuse existing administrator login: rejected because it violates minimum privilege.
Promote cvg_installer to a login: rejected because it is a NOLOGIN capability role with a distinct runtime purpose.
Use a dedicated per-target migration login with only migration-required object grants: selected for local proof; production approval remains open.
design_decision.verification_boundary: Disposable PostgreSQL 16 container, network none, no published ports, Unix socket, synthetic role/secret/data; exact schema, privilege flags, tenant RLS and idempotence were observed.
design_decision.failure_and_recovery: A failed migration stops the local runner; cleanup removes only its owned container/temp directory. Production rollback keeps schema 0175 and redeploys the prior application only after candidate compatibility probes pass.
residual_risks: No production role/secret channel or ownership grant plan has been approved.
No exact release binaries were mixed-version tested.
No restore or schema-down rehearsal was performed.
